# WattsonBot

> Real-time Tesla vehicle monitoring delivered to Telegram. Instant alerts for charging, battery level, tire pressure and drive events — no extra app to install, no dashboard to check.

WattsonBot connects to a Tesla vehicle using a Tesla refresh token (never the account password) and sends notifications straight to a Telegram chat with @WattsonEVBot.

## Pricing
$5/month, one plan, covers one Tesla with unlimited alerts, stats, and history on demand. Starts with a 7-day free trial, no card needed. No auto-renewal: each month is a separate payment in Telegram (Stars or crypto); /billing shows your status.

## Features
- Real-time charging alerts (start, stop, target reached)
- Low-battery and range warnings
- Tire pressure (TPMS) alerts
- Drive start/end summaries with location and energy used
- Stats and history on demand via Telegram commands
- Configurable per-channel notification settings

## Security
Uses a Tesla refresh token, not the account password. The token itself has the same access as the Tesla app, so share it only with a service you trust. WattsonBot only reads vehicle data (location, battery, charging state, tyre pressure) and never sends commands to the car. The token can be revoked at any time by changing the Tesla password.
